source: Imazon CAR cohort (SICAR 9 Oct 2026, active or pending rural properties, Legal Amazon), MapBiomas Collection 11 pasture 2025, PRODES 2009-2025
core80: largest farms first until they hold 80 percent of all cohort CAR pasture in the municipality; CAR overlaps counted gross
cleared_2009_2025_ha: gross PRODES clearing inside the property from 2009 to 2025 (v34 fiscal_property_classes)
no_clearing: deforestation_class_code 0, no PRODES clearing detected inside the property from 2009 to 2025
nearest_plant: straight-line distance from a point inside the property to the nearest slaughterhouse point shown on the site
health_area: farms assigned to the nearest office of each kind; concave hull (ratio 0.3) of the largest farms holding 80 percent of that pasture, buffered and simplified 1.5 km
travel_time: truck minutes on a 1 km friction grid from OSM roads (Geofabrik, Aug 2026) by road class, 8 km/h off mapped roads; multi-source Dijkstra
zones: facility allocation by travel time; 80 percent highest-density region of assigned pasture (farms) or sites (corn/feed) inside the allocation area
